questions: Why do intent_lock and verdict_reconcile disagree about the same report's verdict?
What forms are audit report verdict and target fields actually written in?
What rule closes GH #424 without refusing reports that have been written?

findings.finding: the PASS predicate accepts a PASS-shaped line anywhere, unrelated to the verdict asserted; a VETO report quoting the canonical form authorizes capture
findings.evidence: reproduced against the current tree, both bare and qualified VETO forms

findings.finding: verdict_reconcile matches neither the heading form nor a bolded value nor a backticked or qualified target; it flags 84 of the 189 reports intent_lock accepts
findings.evidence: measured over 204 historical versions of AUDIT_REPORT.md; demonstrated on Phase 262's own report and matching artifact, both PASS

findings.finding: 0 of 204 reports carry disagreeing verdict values, so agreement-required refuses nothing that has ever been written
findings.evidence: measured at the audit-report unit; an earlier pass over all *.md gave 72 of 96 and was wrong, counting the ledger and fixtures

findings.finding: two template files each instruct both verdict forms in one report and have drifted from each other; this is the root cause of the split
findings.evidence: qor/references/ql-audit-templates.md and the qor-audit skill copy, 130 vs 203 lines

findings.finding: verdict_reconcile's wired ABORT produced no observable effect across a continuous run of phases that sealed anyway
findings.evidence: 23 of the 40 most recent reports produce a finding; all those phases reached a seal
